name: Kawauchi (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kawauchi village emblem in white: a ring crossed by a stylised character of horizontal strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Kawauchi, a village in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1978.

features.role: Kawauchi village emblem — a ring crossed by a stylised character of horizontal strokes
